data.gender_notes: Asyur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives support and is successful in all his endeavors. The name Asyur carries the meaning “Support, Strength, Success” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Asyur usually hope their child will grow to embody support, strength, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Asyur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Strength, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asyur total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أسور
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم يعني الحاكم أو المالك أو الزعيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: أسور هو اسم علم عربي يعود أصله إلى اللغة السريانية، ويأتي من كلمة "أسور" التي تعني الحاكم أو المالك أو الزعيم. في الإسلام، يُستخدم اسم أسور لوصف الشخص الذي يمتلك قوة وسلطة وثقافة عالية. يُعتبر أسور اسمًا شائعًا في الأدب والتراث في العصور الوسطى، حيث كانت كلماته تعبر عن العظمة والجلال. في الوقت الحاضر، لا يزال أسور يُستخدم في بعض الثقافات العربية كاسم علم للرجال، ويُحتفظ به بفضل قيمته العالية ومعناه الرائع.

in_urdu.name: اَسوُر
in_urdu.meaning: علمی نام جو حکمران کے معنی ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: اَسوُر ایک علمی نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ملا ہے۔ اس کے معنی حکمران، مالک، یا زعیم کے ہیں۔ اسلامی روایات میں، اَسوُر کو ایک شخص کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو قوتوں پر حکمرانی کرتا ہے اور اعلی ثقافت کا مالک ہے۔ اَسوُر نام قدیم زمانے سے ہی عرب دنیا میں مشہور ہے. اس کے الفاظ کو عظمت اور جلال کی طرف اشارہ کیا جاتا ہے. آج بھی، اَسوُر کو کچھ عرب ثقافتوں میں ایک علمی نام کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام اس کی عظیم قدر اور اس کے بہترین معنی کی وجہ سے محفوظ رہا ہے.

in_hindi.name: असुर
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है साम्राज्य या सत्ता का मालिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: असुर एक इस्लामी नाम है जिसका उद्गम अरबी भाषा से हुआ है। इसका अर्थ है साम्राज्य या सत्ता का मालिक। इस्लामी परंपराओं में असुर को एक व्यक्ति के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो सत्ता पर शासन करता है और उच्च संस्कृति का मालिक होता है। असुर नाम प्राचीन काल से ही भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में प्रसिद्ध है। इसके शब्दों को महानता और गौरव की ओर संकेत किया जाता है। वर्तमान में, असुर को कुछ हिंदू-मुस्लिम संस्कृतियों में एक नाम के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम इसकी उच्च गुणवत्ता और अद्वितीय अर्थ के कारण सुरक्षित है।

in_english.name: Asyur
in_english.meaning: A name that means ruler, lord, or leader, with connotations of power and authority
in_english.long_meaning: Asyur is a name of Arabic origin that signifies a person of great power, authority, and culture. In Islamic tradition, the name Asyur is used to describe someone who possesses strong leadership qualities and a high level of sophistication. The name Asyur has a rich history and cultural significance, with roots in ancient Middle Eastern civilizations. It is still used today in various Muslim cultures as a symbol of strength, wisdom, and noble character. Asyur is a name that evokes a sense of grandeur and majesty, and is often associated with qualities such as courage, intelligence, and diplomacy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Asyur holds a significant cultural impact due to its meaning, "one who gives support," and the values it represents. In Islamic culture, community and support, especially during times of hardship or struggle, are highly valued. The name Asyur, therefore, signifies a strong and reliable individual who is always there to support and uplift those around him. This Quality is a reminder of the importance of treating others with kindness and compassion, as well as the collective power and strength of a community in overcoming challenges and achieving success.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Asyur holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, as it serves as a reminder of the faith and belief in Allah (God) as the ultimate source of support and success. By carrying this name, individuals are encouraged to lean on their faith and trust in Allah to help them navigate life's challenges and achieve their goals. Furthermore, the name Asyur emphasizes the importance of being a source of support and strength for others, emulating the compassionate and caring character of Allah towards His creation. Overall, the name Asyur serves as a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of our lives and the importance of relying on our faith and community to overcome obstacles and find success.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Asyur serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of support, strength, success.

historical_references.reference: Asyur, also known as Ashura, is a significant religious commemoration in Islamic and Shia traditions, marking the martyrdom of Husayn ibn Ali, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad, on the 10th day of Muharram in the year 61 AH (680 AD) during the Battle of Karbala.
historical_references.context: Battle of Karbala and the martyrdom of Husayn ibn Ali

historical_references.reference: Asyur is also observed by many Sunni Muslims as a day of mourning and remembrance for the Prophet Muhammad and his family, particularly for the sacrifice of his grandson, Ali ibn Abi Talib, during the Battle of Uhud (5/625 AD) when he was struck on the head with an arrow and saved the Muslims by his intervention, leading to the day being known as 'The Day of 'Ashura'.
historical_references.context: Battle of Uhud and the sacrifice of Ali ibn Abi Talib

modern_usage.modern_context: Asyur, also known as Ashura, is an important day in the Islamic calendar marking the anniversary of Prophet Muhammad's grandson Imam Hussein's martyrdom. It is observed through various practices including self-flagellation, fasting, and communal mourning. On social media platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook, the modern context of Asyur is reflected through personal and collective sharing of experiences, stories, and symbolic representations. The use of hashtags #Ashura, #Muharram, and #RemembranceOfImamHussein are common on Twitter. Instagram users share images of Mourning processions, symbolic food items, and traditional clothing. Facebook groups and pages are created for organizing and participating in community events such as Muharram processions, sermons, and gatherings.
